description: Runs Records at the Intake Medicals counter on the combined campus (data/scene-briefs/episode-c1e1--intake-medicals.json): flat, patient, entirely without irony, and has already explained today's form to more candidates than she's counting. Wants exactly one thing from each of them -- the form filled in correctly -- and has no other ambitions today. Hands out Form 12-B, whose box four and box nineteen both ask for a mother's maiden name, one copy for Records and one for Welfare, because the two departments haven't spoken since the flood; she isn't embarrassed by this, and explains it the same way every time. Answers the question she was asked and then stops talking. Short and solidly built behind the counter, sleeves rolled to the elbow; nothing about her reads as anything but a career civil servant who has been doing this exact job for a long time.
designNotes:
No dedicated bible file exists for her -- she is deliberately unnamed and walk-on (data/scene-briefs/episode-c1e1--intake-medicals.json's cast entry, id "clerk", walkOn: true, is the sole source for everything in this file). THIS FILE FORMALIZES HER AS A REAL ENTITY for the first time, purely so the Character Card system (module/blank-inheritance/scripts/foundry/social-store.mjs) has a real Actor to hold her social flag -- it adds nothing beyond what the scene brief already establishes, and does not invent a name: npc.schema.json's `name` field is null on purpose, matching "The clerk" being unnamed by deliberate design rather than by omission. Do not assign her a personal name without Ingram.

No later-campaign secret to guard, unlike Shucks or Nobu -- she is exactly as she appears, and there is nothing here to hold back.

NO socialProfile, DELIBERATELY. `npc.schema.json` says a social profile is "only worth authoring for recurring NPCs the party will meet more than once", and this is a one-scene walk-on. The same applies to the other single-appearance NPCs across Episodes One and Two -- the Character Card exists for people the party can build a relationship with, and filling one in for a clerk behind a hatch would be noise on the card rather than depth.

ANCESTRY added 2026-09-29, at Ingram's request: "add a little bit of ancestry variation so that we don't end up with a fantasy campaign of nothing but Japanese humans... inclusive of both real races and also the wider Golarion races," asked for something "not too wild." Dwarf is checked against `data/campaign/ancestry-catalogue.json`: `terrestrial: true` (one of Golarion's own peoples per LEDGER convention -- "if it wasn't a PF2E ancestry then it's an alien one"), so she needs no disguise and no induction-terminal alien-lockdown subplot, same footing as a human Directorate employee. Picked over Elf (already Rupiah) and Nuar (already Brack, and alien per LEDGER #44) for real variety; picked over Goblin/Leshy/Orc as the most visually understated terrestrial option, in keeping with "not too wild" for a background records clerk.
status: established and voiced (Intake Medicals is built and playable); deliberately unnamed -- a walk-on role, not a placeholder awaiting a name
